specs.Connector Type: USB Type A, USB Type C

features: 27000mAh Massive Battery Capacity: The boAt EnergyShroom PB600 is a heavy-duty power bank with a massive 27000mAh capacity, designed to keep your devices powered through multiple charge cycles. Equipped with a Li-ion polymer battery, the PB600 ensures a safe, stable, and efficient charging experience while delivering reliable long-term performance.

4x Output & 2x Input Ports for Multiple Device Charging: The PB600 can charge 4 devices simultaneously with 2x USB-A and 2x Type-C (2-way) ports, all supporting fast charging. It also features 2x Type-C 2-way input ports, allowing you to recharge the power bank quickly and minimize downtime between uses.

2-Way 22.5W Fast Charging Support: Enjoy 22.5W 2-way fast charging, perfect for when you’re in a rush. Smart power management ensures efficient power distribution, even when multiple devices are connected.

Pass-Through Charging: Charge the power bank and your device at the same time—ideal for moments when you’re running low on both time and battery. Your power bank keeps you charged and connected when it matters most.

12-Layer Smart IC Protection: Built with 12 layers of protection, the PB600 safeguards your devices against common threats including overheating, short circuits, over-charging, and over-discharge for safer charging. Whether you’re using one port or all four, your devices remain protected throughout.
